newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian parliament to debate government reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Russian parliament to debate government reshuffle.

text.p: Russia's lower house of parliament was to discuss on Wednesday plans by President Boris Yeltsin for a cabinet reshuffle in which no minister is safe except the prime minister and his new first deputy.
The reshuffle was on the agenda at the request of the opposition Communists, ultra-nationalists and Agrarians.
Yeltsin on Tuesday ordered Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin to present proposals for the changes within a week, making clear that First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais would stay.

Chubais is hated by the opposition Communists for masterminding Yeltsin's successful reelection campaign last year and for his role in overseeing privatisation, in which they say state assets were sold off too cheaply.
